build_bond_matrix: build a python module to construct a bond adjacency matrix for a pymatgen crystal structure using a NearNeighbors finder
build_bond_matrix_with_permutations: build a python module to construct a bond matrix with custom site permutations for reordered atom sites
create_nn_adjacency: create a function that uses pymatgen NearNeighbors to generate a binary adjacency matrix indicating covalent bonds between atoms
review_construct_bond_matrix: review the construct_bond_matrix function and its use of site permutations to reorder the bond matrix indices
test_construct_bond_matrix: test the construct_bond_matrix function with a pymatgen Structure and NearNeighbors instance to verify correct bond detection
